page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g5.16xlarge is a general-purpose virtual instance built on the x86_64 architecture using KVM virtualization. Powered by an Intel Xeon Platinum 8163 processor operating at a clock speed of 2.5 GHz, it provides 64 dedicated vCPUs. The system is equipped with 256.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU core.

This instance configuration includes a 20 Gbps baseline network bandwidth for external data transfers. It features no local ephemeral storage, requiring reliance on external block storage services for persistent data volumes. Additionally, no discrete GPUs are bundled. The balanced compute-to-memory allocation makes the ecs.g5.16xlarge instance suited for enterprise application servers, container orchestration clusters, batch processing, and general enterprise workloads.
